entries.text: A dry run never installs a package, and driver auto-install is now explicit: it prints the exact package==version before installing, and a non-interactive session refuses it with exit 6 unless BENCHBOX_DRIVER_AUTO_INSTALL=1 is set.
details: driver_auto_install=true as a platform option still installs in a terminal session, but no longer in a non-interactive one; set BENCHBOX_DRIVER_AUTO_INSTALL=1 there.
driver_version must be a valid package version such as 1.2.3; anything else is refused before it reaches pip or uv.

entries.text: A Databricks dry run no longer contacts the workspace to look for SQL warehouses, and run-official accepts --acknowledge-billable-platform like run and compare.

benchbox run --help states what each --force value deletes, locally and on remote platforms, benchbox platforms install says it only prints instructions, and the billable-platform flag help lists the paths it does not guard.
